flyer.justification: The flyer adheres closely to all formatting requirements including a 5-word title and TBA placeholders, accurately summarizing the talk.

linkedin.justification: The post captures the key points and narrative well without banned cliches, but fails to include the required 3-5 hashtags.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter fully meets all instructions, featuring a subject line under 50 characters, three distinct bold subheadings, and strong editorial flow.

instagram.justification: The caption fulfills all format criteria, including carousel visual cues, emojis, call to action, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

summary.justification: The summary contains all required structural components (TL;DR, key evidence, discussion points, action items) well within the 400-word limit.

blog.justification: The blog covers the core themes thoroughly with a comparison table, but omits the required numbered section headings and the 'About the Author' section.
